items.text: Texans RB David Montgomery (groin), WR Tank Dell (knee), and S Jalen Pitre (shoulder) will not travel to London and are ruled OUT vs. Jaguars.
items.why: Will not travel; groin for Montgomery
items.implication: Full snaps/touches for backup RB; passing game volume up
items.opportunity: Lead back role and near-100% snaps for next man up; more targets for remaining WRs/TEs

items.text: Eagles QB Jalen Hurts is out indefinitely with a superficial blood clot that showed movement on follow-up ultrasound; Tanner McKee will start vs. Panthers. Health is priority; no sugarcoating the situation.
items.why: Blood clot movement after initial London game clearance
items.implication: McKee starts; Eagles offense limited, implied total dropped; boost Goedert/others in pass game
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for Dallas Goedert and remaining WRs if Smith limited

items.text: Bills WR DJ Moore DNP second straight day (shoulder); Cardinals rookie RB Jeremiyah Love DNP second straight (ankle).
items.implication: Moore status vs Raiders uncertain; Love availability vs Rams questionable, limits rookie role
items.opportunity: If Moore out, other Bills WRs; if Love out, other ARI RBs elevate

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley (hamstring) no practice again Thursday; WR DeVonta Smith upgraded to limited. Pair with Hurts OUT creates major uncertainty vs. Panthers.
items.implication: Barkley game-time or OUT risk; Smith more likely active; McKee-led offense lean
items.opportunity: If Barkley OUT, handcuff/backups elevate; Goedert already seeing high target share

items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson (ankle) DNP again Thursday; Chiefs WR Rashee Rice (hamstring) also DNP again.
items.implication: Jackson return uncertain (Huntley ready); Rice risky or OUT
items.opportunity: If Lamar out, Likely/Andrews/Flowers volume; if Rice out, Worthy/others

items.text: Bears QB Caleb Williams full participant second straight day, on track to start vs. Falcons after hamstring issue.
items.implication: Expected starter; Bears offense fully operational
items.opportunity: Normal dropbacks and rush upside restored

items.text: Raiders RB Ashton Jeanty said ankle feeling great, best he's felt this season, expects to play vs. Bills. Positive step after playing through pain.
items.implication: Fuller workload likely; RB1 upside intact in high-total game
items.opportunity: Maintained or expanded carries/routes if fully healthy

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson multi-week high-ankle; Rhamondre Stevenson saw 85% snaps/23 touches in prior absence and averages 16.3 PPG on 15+ touches. Bhayshul Tuten snap/utilization rising weekly (77 Util Score). Montgomery out = full snaps for next RB.
items.why: Historical snap/touch data + weekly utilization trends
items.implication: Stevenson RB1/2 lock; Tuten flex rising; Montgomery handcuff must-add
items.opportunity: Near-feature back volume for Stevenson; increasing routes/targets for Tuten; full RB workload post-Montgomery

items.text: Broncos WR Jaylen Waddle questionable to return with shoulder in TNF vs Seahawks, then returned to the game.
items.implication: Played through; limited impact possible post-injury
items.opportunity: Routes/targets if fully effective; monitor for lingering
items.conflict: Berry hates Waddle this week on usage/matchup

items.text: Eagles gold standard moving on from aging stars early (Dawkins, McNabb, McCoy, Ertz etc.). Saquon turns 30 in Feb; if contender with RB need, at least call now rather than year too late.
items.why: Age + Eagles trade history precedent; opportunity/role focus
items.implication: Sell-high window if contending teams inquire; monitor for trade rumors amid injury
items.opportunity: Handcuff value rises with current hamstring uncertainty

items.text: LOVE Mike Evans vs WSH as WR4; Commanders secondary buffet for pass catchers. Season-high target share recently, especially with Deebo out multi-week.
items.why: Matchup + elevated target share (36% recently) with Deebo Samuel out multi weeks
items.implication: Top-5 WR play this week; strong start

items.text: LOVE Drake London (WR6 vs CHI), George Kittle (TE3 vs WSH), Kyren Williams (RB5 vs ARI) on volume + soft matchups. Javonte Williams (RB8) and Rhamondre Stevenson (RB9) also loved for goal-line/volume.
items.why: Usage bankable + defenses leaking vs pass/run; Stevenson volume with Henderson multi-week out
items.implication: Strong starts across positions; Stevenson borderline RB1

items.text: HATE Jaylen Waddle (WR28 vs SEA), Emeka Egbuka (WR34 vs PIT), Kyle Pitts (TE18 vs CHI) on ugly matchups and shaky QB/usage.
items.why: Tough defenses + low recent production/target consistency for Waddle (most yards in one game)
items.conflict: Waddle returned from in-game Q but usage still concern

items.text: HATE J.K. Dobbins (RB27 vs SEA), Bo Nix (QB23 vs SEA), Justin Herbert (QB25 @ KC) due to tough run/pass defenses and low team totals.
items.why: Elite defenses shutting down run/pass; Herbert scoring rut
